workflowId.cachedResultName: [NWI] Deal Closed Won -> BC Customer + Sales Order

parameters.content:
## NWI - Dispatcher: set up before publishing
1. Connect credential on the Webhook node: header auth (see note on HubSpot headers in the PR).
2. On *Run Deal -> BC Sales Order* pick the sub-workflow **[NWI] Deal Closed Won -> BC Customer + Sales Order** from the list.
3. Settings -> Error Workflow: set the shared error handler.
4. Confirm *Workflow Config*: trigger property `closed_won` (value `true`). Create it as a single checkbox on Deal.
5. In the HubSpot developer app, subscribe to deal property changes on **closed_won** and point it at the PRODUCTION URL (shown on the Webhook node) after publishing.

**Fan-out:** one webhook call can hold many deals. Each deal runs the sub-workflow once, one at a time.
